Writ Petition filed under Article 226 of the Constitution of Ind
 issue a Writ of Mandamus directing the respondents to consider the
 representation dated 17.11.2021 and complete the proceed
 determination of the compensation under Section 7 of the Tamil Nadu
 Acquisition of Land for Industrial Purposes Act (Tamil Nadu Act 10 of 19
 with respect of the acquisition of the land of the petitioners of an ext
 cents situated in Survey No.19/9, Block No.15, Unit-2, Patta No.707 of N
 Village, Sriperumbudur Taluk, Kancheepuram District acquired for the Sip
 Mannur-Vallarpuram-Nimili Scheme Industrial Purpose within a time frame 
 be fixed by this Court.

For Respondents : Ms.Akila Rajendran
 Government Advocate

Order
The petitioners herein have given a representation to the respondents on 17.11.2021 seeking for a direction to the respondents to consider the representation dated 17.11.2021 and complete the proceedings for determination of the compensation under Section 7 of the Tamil Nadu https://www.mhc.tn.gov.in/judis Acquisition of Land for Industrial Purposes Act (Tamil Nadu Act 10 of 1999) with respect of the acquisition of the land of the petitioners of an extent of 0.36 cents situated in Survey No.19/9, Block No.15, Unit-2, Patta No.707 of Nemili Village, Sriperumbudur Taluk, Kancheepuram District acquired for the SIPCOT Mannur-Vallarpuram-Nimili Scheme Industrial Purpose.
Since the said representation was not considered, the present writ petition has been filed.

2. It is needless to point out that whenever a representation of this nature is made to a Statutory Authority, there is a duty cast upon the respondents to consider the same on its own merits and pass appropriate orders in one way or other, instead of keeping the same pending indefinitely.

As such,
non- consideration of the representation by the Statutory Authority would amount to dereliction of duty and hence, this Court will be justified in invoking its extraordinary powers under Article 226 of Constitution of India and direct them to consider the same within a stipulated time.

3. In the light of the above observations, there shall be a direction to the respondents herein to consider the petitioners representation dated 17.11.2021 https://www.mhc.tn.gov.in/judis on its own merits and pass appropriate orders in accordance with law, within a period of twelve weeks P.R.Arumainathan vs The State Of Tamil Nadu on 15 March, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/145537284/
2 from the date of receipt of a copy of this order.
